prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: The person's right hand is away from the scanner/base with a clear gap and no visible touching or grasping.
The person's right hand is hovering/reaching but is visibly separated from the scanner/base with a clear gap.
The person's right hand is hovering/approaching but remains visibly separated from the scanner object.
Right hand is hovering near the scanner with a visible gap; no physical touch or grasp is visible.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a clear gap and no touch.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but a visible gap remains; no clear touching or grasping is shown.
Right hand is close to the scanner but no clear visible touch or overlap; contact is ambiguous.
Right hand is reaching near the scanner but a visible gap remains; no clear physical touch.
Right hand is very close to the scanner/base, but visible physical touch or grasp is not clearly shown.
The person's right hand/fingers are visibly grasping the pink scanner with no gap.
The person's right hand/fingers visibly overlap and press against the pink scanner/base with no clear gap, indicating contact.
